title: Tamra Williams wins the Big “R” Pacesetter Award
excerpt: The Rowlett Lions Club president was honored at the Chamber's Hometown Heroes banquet for moving Rowlett forward.
coverAlt: Hometown hero: Big R Pacesetter Award
body:
At the Rowlett Area Chamber & Visitors Center's Hometown Heroes Awards Banquet on August 27, Tamra Williams received the Big “R” Pacesetter Award. The honor goes to someone whose leadership and initiative move the whole community forward.

As president of the Rowlett Lions Club, Williams led the club through a year of nearly $46,000 in donations to causes like Texas Lions Camp, the Hope in Hand Food Pantry, St. Vincent de Paul, the Rowlett Needy Children's Fund and local scholarships.

She has also teamed up with groups across town, including the N.E.D.C. Kiwanis Club, Rowlett CERT, the Rowlett Chamber of Commerce and Rowlett Strong.

True to form, Williams shared the credit, saying the award belongs just as much to the members who serve alongside her.

Congratulations, Tamra – and thank you.
